description: Recovery kit backup (spec §3.12). file = cjson({"v":1,"alg":"argon2id-xc20p-kit","vault_id","account","recovery_sign_pub","s","t","m","p","n","ct"}); K_pw = Argon2id(NFC(passphrase), s, t, m, p, 32); key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=K_pw, salt=utf8("akv1"), info=utf8("akv1/kit-backup-key"), L=32); aad = cjson({"ctx":"akv1/kit-backup","vault_id","account","recovery_sign_pub","t","m","p"}); ct = XChaCha20-Poly1305(key, n, cjson({"v":1,"vault_id","account","vault_origin","recovery_key"}), aad). Argon2id bounds t 3..10, m 65536..524288 KiB, p 1..4, checked before any KDF work. Opening takes the expected account (and optionally vault_id and recovery_sign_pub); a mismatch is bad_request before any KDF work. Sealing requires a passphrase of at least 12 code points after NFC; opening accepts any non-empty one. All passphrases, keys and identifiers here are synthetic.
